correctness.rationale: Using the specified two-stage Radau IIA Q and c, deletion-indicator zero forces an affine collocation polynomial a+bt. Equal logistic derivatives imply U1=U2 (excluded by h>0,a∈(0,1)) or U1+U2=1. Solving yields h=12(1-2a)/((1+2a)(3-2a)), U1=(1+2a)/4, U2=(3-2a)/4 with positive h iff a<1/2. The true logistic hitting time H(s)=2atanh(s)+2atanh(s/2) exceeds h(s)=12s/(4-s²) by strictly positive coefficients from s^5; thus true endpoint below U2 and max absolute error supremum 3/4 as a→0. Independently recomputed resultant 192(3x-1)(81x³-27x²-26x-8) at (a,h)=(1/6,9/4); x<=77/192 rules out cubic for [0,1]^2, and y=2/3 is unique. Fourteen rational parameter values verified with exact substitutions. No solver-convergence statement is inferred.
